notes.message: I met Micah way back in 2015 (10 years ago??) when we were proctors / student research assistants at the good ol TACC Vislab at UT Austin. We collab'd on a bunch of cool projects on multi touch and immersive technologies and generally had good times. Over the summer I remember making a cool promo video for Google Glass research and Micah was the star actor and our buddy RJ made the background piano music. Happy birthday bro! Keep in touch 🚀
